dict.string: Earshot automates apps such as Mail, Notes and Shortcuts to carry out actions you approve.
Earshot checks your calendar so it never interrupts a meeting, and adds events you mention once you approve them.
Earshot saves notes as Markdown files in your Documents folder (Documents/Earshot Notes unless you choose another folder).
Earshot runs a small server on your local network so your Apple Watch can upload recordings and receive questions.
Earshot can use this Mac's microphone in desk mode to transcribe your day when you are not wearing your Apple Watch.
Earshot turns tasks and commitments you mention into reminders once you approve them.
Earshot transcribes the audio recorded by your Apple Watch or this Mac with Apple speech recognition, on this Mac.
